007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.datasource;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import oracle.jdbc.pool.OracleDataSource;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016import javax.sql.DataSource;
017import java.sql.SQLException;
018import java.util.List;
019
020/**
021 * Sample for listing Select AI profiles using DataSource-backed connection mode.
022 *
023 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create an Oracle JDBC {@link DataSource},
024 * pass it to {@link SelectAI#create(DataSource)}, call
025 * {@link SelectAI#listProfiles()}, and print profile metadata returned by the
026 * SDK.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
029 * <ul>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
033 * </ul>
034 *
035 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
036 * <pre>{@code
037 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
038 * }</pre>
039 *
040 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
041 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
042 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * mvn clean install
045 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
046 * }</pre>
047 *
048 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
049 * <pre>{@code
050 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
051 *   -d samples/out \
052 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/datasource/ListProfilesWithDataSourceSample.java
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
058 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.datasource.ListProfilesWithDataSourceSample
059 * }</pre>
060 *
061 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
062 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
063 * and diagnostics.</p>
064 */
065public final class ListProfilesWithDataSourceSample {
066    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ListProfilesWithDataSourceSample.class);
067
068    private ListProfilesWithDataSourceSample() {
069    }
070
071    public static void main(String[] args) {
072        try {
073            DataSource dataSource = createDataSource();
074
075            SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(dataSource);
076
077            List<Profile> profiles = selectAI.listProfiles();
078
079            if (profiles.isEmpty()) {
080                System.out.println("No Select AI profiles found.");
081                return;
082            }
083
084            System.out.printf("Found %d Select AI profile(s):%n", profiles.size());
085            for (Profile profile : profiles) {
086                System.out.println("----------------------------------------");
087                System.out.printf("Profile name : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getProfileName()));
088                System.out.printf("Status       : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getStatus()));
089                System.out.printf("Description  : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getDescription()));
090            }
091        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
092            LOGGER.error("Failed to list Select AI profiles using DataSource mode.", e);
093        } catch (SQLException e) {
094            LOGGER.error("Failed to configure OracleDataSource.", e);
095        }
096    }
097
098    private static DataSource createDataSource() throws SQLException {
099        OracleDataSource dataSource = new OracleDataSource();
100        dataSource.setURL(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"));
101        dataSource.setUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"));
102        dataSource.setPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"));
103        return dataSource;
104    }
105
106    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
107        String value = System.getenv(name);
108        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
109            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
110        }
111        return value;
112    }
113
114    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
115        return value == null ? "" : value;
116    }
117}
